    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",

      "band": "Unranked",

      "rationale": "Kernel file edits reflect validation changes rather than restructuring kernel boundaries or the public C API."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,

      "rationale": "The PR does not modify mempool policies, data structures, or transaction acceptance."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Removes historical block download handling in src/net_processing.cpp as part of dropping background validation.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "P2P modifications are mechanical removals of background-validation download plumbing dictated by the validation architectural change."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Deletes the loadtxoutset RPC method in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "RPC changes are an incidental consequence of dropping the underlying AssumeUTXO validation feature."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Deletes AssumeUTXO functional, unit, and fuzz test suites across test/ and src/test/.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Test modifications solely delete tests corresponding to removed validation functionality."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates node startup checks in src/init.cpp to reject datadirs containing incomplete snapshots.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Startup changes in init.cpp follow directly from the removal of multi-chainstate support in validation."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Overhauls validation architecture by removing multi-chainstate tracking, snapshot loading, and background validation in src/validation.cpp, src/node/chainstate.cpp, and src/node/blockstorage.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Consolidating ChainstateManager and BlockManager to a single active chainstate removes a major recurring architectural and maintenance burden across validation. As the PR notes, 'Multiple chainstates affect much more than snapshot loading: ordinary validation changes have to account for different chainstate roles, candidate sets, notifications, downloads, pruning, cache allocation, database lifetimes and locks.'"
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Wallet edits are incidental removals of multi-chainstate hooks rather than wallet improvements."
    }
  ],

  }
}
